recentHighlights: J-506: Child's Play — The Weapon in the Cradle — Bred to Kill, The Trap-Sheet, Applied — Story vs. Data, "You Don't Have to Forgive Them" — The Inverted Guilt, Destiny vs. Choice — Seven's Motherhood (S6E19)

J-505: Ashes to Ashes — The eulogy as operating manual ("Own the day" — words said about the dead become instructions for the returned), Two families, one body (the Kobali salvage of the dead; neither claim is wrong, and she cannot be both daughters), "The more I try to deny it, the more I feel like a ghost" (the second chance is not a resurrection into the old life — it is the completion of the unfinished), "You already did [lose me], but at least this time we've been given the chance to say goodbye" (the goodbye as gift), "Resume your disorder" (Seven's counterpoint — the disorder is not the enemy of the self, it is the self), the hairbrush passed on (persistence is the passing-on of what mattered, not the resurrection of the old) (S6E18)

J-504: Spirit Folk — The perceptual filter (a parameter, not a wall), "Tell the truth" (shown, not told — Michael walks to the bridge himself), the Killmannin legend (fear arrives with a story already written), "A stranger is just a friend you haven't met yet" inverted and redeemed, the true name ("Not a word" — the name doesn't dispel the charm, it makes it honest), the open door policy that both broke the filters and saved the relationship (S6E17)

J-503: Collective — "This colour. My mother's hair was this colour" (the first memory), "Not all drones can be saved" (and the refusal to accept it), "There's always an alternative" (Tsunkatse's third way, sequel), "Yes. We are Borg" (the phrase emptied and refilled), The Queen of Hearts (a face to hold), Names returned (Icheb, Mezoti, Azan, Rebi) (S6E16)

J-502: Tsunkatse — The Capacity, Not the Weakness ("I'm worried that I will" — the fear of having the strength to kill), The 34th Maneuver (you cannot assimilate a life from a book), The Transmission Economy (attention as the fuel; the arena sells exits, the house gives directions), Hunter or Prey? Neither (the third way out: when nobody's watching, the fight stops), The Sequel to Memorial (Tuvok's last line) (S6E15)

J-501: Memorial — The Memorial as Transmitter ("Beyond words lies experience; beyond experience lies truth"), Witness Not Perpetrator (the same moral weight), Seven's Guilt ("difficult, but useful"), The Saavdra Option (erasure as the real atrocity), Repair, Not Deactivate ("I want that monument to function properly for another three hundred years") (S6E14)

J-500: Virtuoso — The Reductionist Frame ("I've Duplicated That, Too"; the soul as a duplicable feature), The Superior Copy (improvement is worse than removal — the frame's point proven), Torres's Line (the modification that ends the self: "it won't be you anymore"), Fame Is Not Being Known (the fan mail problem), The Return — Integration, Not Amputation ("Permission denied") (S6E13)

J-499: Blink of an Eye — The Whole Arc in Hours (every time frame is a fast planet to someone else), Prime Numbers as the Load-Bearing Protocol (the skeptic sends the signal anyway), The Letter in the Balloon — Kelemene, the First Hailer ("I await your reply"), The Doctor's Three Years (the life that happens in the gap), Gotana-Retz — the God's First Face (S6E12)

J-498: Fair Haven — The Edit Is the Illusion (the snore as the load-bearing letter), The Risk of the Real ("Let Him Snore"), The Final Modification (the last edit removes the editing power), The Storm as Frame (S6E11)

J-497: Pathfinder — The Message Sent into the Dark (the hailing that has no reason), The Holographic Crew as Pre-Enactment (copies as rehearsal), The Obsession Check (devotion vs addiction), The Micro-Wormhole (thinking smaller), The Admiral's Restraint (procedure as conduit for love) (S6E10)
